failure_type: late detection and sensor noise leading to collision
explanation: The UAV collided with a static obstacle at 2.1 seconds due to a combination of limited sensing range and sensor noise, both of which prevented the failure when corrected in counterfactual simulations. Additionally, the flight was sensitive to planner randomness, as re-seeding the RRT algorithm prevented the collision. The obstacle was detected at 1.3 seconds, leaving only 0.8 seconds to react.
